match: exact genomic chromosome + 1-based position + REF + ALT
selection: all frozen existing variant keys; no model response selection
output_policy: successful complete query with no hit = no_match_in_open_GDC_release; failed/incomplete = query_unresolved
consequences: all returned transcripts retained; canonical separately recorded
disease_scope: TCGA open somatic occurrence annotation; neither pathogenicity nor RBP binding truth
